description: National Wetlands Inventory is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by publisher not stated on the toolkit page. The Inventory provides the information necessary to manage America’s wetland habitats and their associated ecosystem benefits. The Wetlands Mapper gives users a way to explore the extent and status of the nation’s wetland and deepwater habitats, as well as changes to these habitats over time. Two reports are available:. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems. Assets: Aquatic and Marine Resources, Natural Areas and Wildlife. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
